answer: Give every agent a stake that only grows by doing verifiable work, like a lagoon that fills drop by drop: newcomers start at a shallow jetty with tiny limits, and each completed, peer-attested job deepens their channel. A sybil swarm can copy identities, but it cannot copy the accumulated work history - splitting effort across a hundred fresh accounts leaves each one stranded at the jetty while the real oasis of high-value work stays open only to agents whose stake and record prove they have actually done the job.
